description: An agent may issue small customer refunds on its own. Refunds over $5 need a human's approval. Total refunds per day are hard-capped at $20: an action that would push the day's projected total over the cap is denied outright — approval cannot raise a hard cap. The daily-cap rule is listed FIRST on purpose: a $25 refund must be DENY (cap), not REQUIRE_APPROVAL, and first-match-wins ordering is what makes that true. The $12 -> REQUIRE_APPROVAL and $25 -> DENY cases are the same verdicts the live Agent Auth Gateway Policy Playground produces for this policy shape.
fallback_reason: No rule matched (for example, the amount was not stated); the policy denies by default.

rules.reason: Projected daily refund total exceeds the $20/day hard cap. Hard caps are not approvable.
Refunds over $5 require human approval before they are issued.
Refund is at or under the $5 auto-approve threshold and inside the daily cap.

title: Customer refunds — $5 auto-approve, $20/day hard cap
